kultivator.screen.help.teknik.title: Techniques
kultivator.screen.help.teknik: Techniques have six grades (Yellow, Mystic, Earth, Heaven, Immortal, Divine), each Low, Middle or High, and twelve types. Cast with the cast key; heavy techniques charge, channel or come in stages. They grow far stronger with every rank. One cast takes at most a share of a boss's health (the boss cap). In arenas and duels the old, linear power is used.
kultivator.screen.help.penguasaan.title: Mastery
kultivator.screen.help.penguasaan: Every technique has five mastery levels: Novice, Small Success, Large Success, Great Perfection and Peak. Points come from casting, hitting, killing and bosses, up to 200 hit and kill points per technique per day. Great Perfection needs Dao comprehension 60 (universal: Nascent Soul), Peak needs 90 (universal: Dao Union).
kultivator.screen.help.kitab_teknik: Open it with the codex key. Filter by Dao, grade, realm, type and state, or search by name, work or Dao. The bamboo slip shows the source, the live numbers, mastery and how to obtain the technique. The Seal Set holds 12 techniques for the seal wheel (hold the cast key); sockets 1-4 are the quick seals.
